s: Seen by everyone you book, and on FF Party.
lead: Your Company Profile does two things.
body: It goes to everyone you book, so your staff know who they're working for.
And it goes on FF Party, so people can find your company and book your services.

lead: Book the right people for every event, in a few taps.
body: Start with your Event Card, add the roles you need, then choose who works each shift. Everyone gets their Shift card on WhatsApp and confirms there.

lead: Create Service Cards in minutes, to show every potential customer what your company can offer them.
body: Instead of generic enquiries, you receive full, complete bookings for your approval.

Every Service Card comes in Bronze, Silver and Gold, so customers choose the level that suits them: Bronze for best value, Silver for the middle ground, and Gold for the best quality. You can give each customer an accurate quote for the level they pick.
Customers can also add cocktails to their package.

lead: List your company's cocktail menu and your signature cocktails.
body: Customers can find you by searching for your cocktails, and when they book you, they can book you for your signature cocktails.

s: Times, pay and terms for each person.
lead: One clear card for every person you book.
body: Each Shift card holds the role, start and finish, pay and your T&Cs. Add a second role and it copies the first, so a full team takes moments.

lead: Every professional on FF Staff has a Profile Card with their skills, experience and reviews.
body: Search by name, profession, skill or area, and see who's closest to your event on the map.

lead: Everyone you book and rate well becomes part of your team.
body: Your team shows first when you choose staff, so the people you like working with are always a tap away.

lead: Staff review you and you review them, after every booking.
body: Good reviews help you book the best people again, and help them find more work.

s: FF Team, FF Staff and FF Party.
lead: One login for all of FireFlair.
body: FF Team is where professionals build their Profile Cards. FF Staff is where businesses book them. FF Party is where anyone plans a party.
